title: 第9章 升级士兵第10章 招募满员
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
“我变高了！我变壮了！”
哥布矛兴奋的大喊大叫，他还拉着哥布大作比较，对比双方的身高差距。
对于哥布林这种没有亲情观念的魔物来说，起码有八成的哥布林都死在了幼崽期，如果没李秦武出现，哥布矛最大的可能就是饿死，或者哪天因为食物短缺，被成年哥布林捉去吃掉。
可一旦成长为成年哥布林，相对来说就有了“人权”，不再是随随便便就能被杀掉的幼崽，怎么也得首领来杀。
现在李秦武队伍里三人都是哥布林了，只有耗材处于幼崽阶段。
耗材看其他人都比自己高，眼里全是羡慕。
李秦武拍了拍他的肩膀激励道：“以后要服从我的命令，不要这么胆小，胆小的哥布林长不高！”
说完他让哥布矛再去搞几条鱼，他要继续刷经验。
接下来的几个小时里，李秦武用同样的方法又干掉了7只角鳄，连升3级，抵达了6级。
他把所有属性点到活力上，他的活力属性从5变成了8，身高也来到了1.4米，看上去初具人形，和个人类少年似的。
他的第纳尔数量积攒到710，接下来很长一段时间，他什么都不干也够维护部队了。
此外，物资收获也非常丰厚，仓库里躺着8张角鳄皮，3个角鳄角，两根角鳄筋。
角鳄的角非常的短，大概普通人大拇指这么长。
系统词条说这玩意是角鳄在河流中探测水魔力流动用的，是异世界生物发展出的独有器官。
系统词条还说这玩意可以入药，是非常好的魔法原料。
能跟魔法扯上关系的物品肯定很值钱，李秦武让它们安稳躺在仓库里，以后应该有用。
至于两根角鳄的筋，这就非常有意思了，这玩意是天然的弦，可以拿来做弓。
不过弓身是个大问题，他们现在找不到够结实又有弹性的材料，就是找到了也没有适合的刀具加工。
只能随便找根结实且平直的木棍当做弓身了。
李秦武让哥布林们分散寻找木棍，众哥布林忙活了好一会儿，回来后每个人都拿着好几根平直的木棍。

李秦武挑出两根坚固和柔韧程度最好的，用尖锐的指甲在木棍两边刻上槽位。
他加了这么多活力，不但长高了，指甲也长长了，而且很锋利，勉强可以当刀片用。
刻好槽位，他把筋拴在两个槽位上，两把简陋至极的木弓就做好了。
李秦武尝试拉了拉弓，感觉还行，弓弦拉开后能提供弹力，只是不能拉太满，不然弓身会折断。
他将弓放下，对几个哥布林道：“接下来去找树枝，要这么细，要直。”
李秦武比划了一下粗细，哥布林们又散开，不一会又抓着一把树枝回来。
李秦武选了1根最合适的，用尖锐的指甲把树枝上的树皮剥掉，他点燃一捧篝火，把剥过皮的树枝放在篝火边烤。
这么做是为了烤干树枝里的水分，脱水的过程中树枝会形变，只要不停调整烘烤位置，它就会变得越来越平直。
不一会儿，李秦武得到一根粗细长短适中，并且十分平直的小木棍。
这还不算完，他又将木棍头部放在火上烧，等木棍头部烧的漆黑碳化后，他把棍尖放在石头上打磨，复烧复磨两三次，他得到一根简陋至极的箭。
content_en:
"I'm taller! I'm stronger!"
Gob Mao shouted excitedly, and he even pulled Gob to compare, comparing the height difference between the two sides.
For monsters like goblins that have no concept of family affection, at least 80% of goblins died in the cub stage. If Li Qinwu had not appeared, Goblin Spear would most likely have died of starvation, or one day he would have been caught and eaten by adult goblins due to food shortages.
But once they grow into adult goblins, they have "human rights" relatively speaking. They are no longer cubs that can be killed casually. They have to be killed by the leader no matter what.
Now three people in Li Qinwu's team are goblins, and only the consumables are in the cub stage.
Consumables saw that other people were taller than him, and his eyes were full of envy.
Li Qinwu patted his shoulder and encouraged him: "In the future, you must obey my orders and don't be so timid. Timid goblins don't grow tall!"
After saying that, he asked Gobu Mao to catch a few more fish, and he wanted to continue gaining experience.
In the next few hours, Li Qinwu used the same method to kill 7 more horned crocodiles, upgrading three levels in a row, reaching level 6.
He focused all attributes on vitality. His vitality attribute changed from 5 to 8, and his height reached 1.4 meters. He looked like he was beginning to take on a human shape, resembling a teenager.
His dinar amount accumulated to 710, which was enough for him to maintain the army without doing anything for a long time.
In addition, the material harvest was also very rich. There were 8 crocodile skins, 3 crocodile horns, and two crocodile tendons lying in the warehouse.
The horns of the horned crocodile are very short, about as long as an average person's thumb.
The system entry says that this thing is used by horned crocodiles to detect the flow of water magic in rivers. It is a unique organ developed by creatures from other worlds.
The system entry also said that this stuff can be used as medicine and is a very good magic ingredient.
Items related to magic must be valuable. Li Qinwu let them lie safely in the warehouse. They should be useful in the future.
As for the two horned crocodile tendons, this is very interesting. They are natural strings and can be used to make bows.
However, the bow body is a big problem. They can't find materials that are strong and elastic enough, and even if they find them, they don't have suitable cutting tools for processing.
I can only find a strong and straight wooden stick as the bow body.
Li Qinwu asked the goblins to disperse and look for sticks. The goblins worked hard for a while, and when they came back, each of them came back with several straight sticks.
Li Qinwu selected the two sticks that were the strongest and most flexible, and used sharp nails to carve slots on both sides of the sticks.
He has added so much energy that not only has he grown taller, but his nails have also grown long and are so sharp that they can barely be used as blades.
After carving out the slots, he tied the tendons to the two slots, and two extremely simple wooden bows were ready.
Li Qinwu tried to pull the bow, and it felt okay. The bow string could provide elasticity after being stretched, but it should not be pulled too full, otherwise the bow would break.
He put down his bow and said to a few goblins: "Next, look for branches. They must be thin and straight."
Li Qinwu made a gesture, and the goblins scattered again, and soon came back with a handful of branches.
Li Qinwu chose the most suitable one, peeled off the bark on the branch with sharp nails, lit a bonfire, and roasted the peeled branches beside the bonfire.
This is done to dry out the moisture in the branches. The branches will deform during the dehydration process. As long as you keep adjusting the baking position, it will become straighter and straighter.
After a while, Li Qinwu got a small wooden stick of medium thickness, length, and very straight.
That wasn't enough, he put the head of the stick on the fire and burned it. After the head of the stick was burnt black and carbonized, he polished the tip of the stick on a stone, burned it and polished it two or three times, and finally he got an extremely crude arrow.
